lines.zh: 我一步一晃，像个软东西。
lines.en: I waddle along, soft-bodied.
My feet leave prints in the mud.
I walk swinging my arms.
My body is yellow.
A smell follows where I walk.
I shuffle, in no hurry.
I go around a tree.
My foot sinks into shallow water.
I stop and catch my breath.
My claws are soft.
I drag my steps.
I step on a bug.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵在泥里抖了抖。
lines.en: My ears twitch in the mud.
My hands hang at my sides.
I am looking for something to eat.
My mouth smacks twice.

lines.zh: 泥巴色的我，抓了抓肚子。
lines.en: Mud-colored, I scratch my belly.
I sit in the mud.
Mud covers me and I cannot be bothered to wipe it.
I wait for someone to feed me.
I am listening to the sounds of the woods.
I smear mud on myself.
I scratch my neck.
Do you have food?
I lift my head from the mud.

lines.zh: 你手上那个闻起来不错。
lines.en: That in your hand smells good.
I am not very active.

lines.zh: 一格的成熟体，蹲下才看清。
lines.en: A one-block Adult—crouch to see me clearly.
Yellow all over. Take a sniff.
Don't tease me with food.

lines.zh: 我记得你的味道，手里已经备好。
lines.en: I remember your scent; my hand is ready.
I hold out a soft hand.
Do you mean to take me with you?
You look thin.
I ease back onto my rump.

lines.zh: 我从泥里抬头看你，你带着吃的吗？
lines.en: I lift my head from the mud — do you have food?
I wobbled all over.
I make a wet, sticky sound.
I waddle behind the tree.
I hold my belly.
Soft legs, but I still move.
I shake the mud off.
I shuffle into the mud.
I watch you from the mud.
Is that food in your hand?

lines.zh: 我够不到你手，肚子先叫了。
lines.en: I cannot reach your hand; my belly growls first.
Too short. I can't reach.
That smell makes me burp.
I open my mouth wide.
Don't pull back; I nearly have it.
One more bite in your hand?
I sit and wait.
That thing in your hand is big.
One bite and I'd have it.
My soft legs give a step.

lines.zh: 我肚子上的泥蹭了你一片。
lines.en: The mud on my belly smears across you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我摊在泥里的手。
lines.en: You stepped on my hand in the mud.
I wobble into you.
We bump with a soft sound.
I drag my belly aside.
I plop down in the mud.

lines.zh: 撞一下而已，我又没使劲。
lines.en: Just a bump — I wasn't even trying.

lines.zh: 我只是个软绵绵的东西。
lines.en: I am just a soft thing.
I don't quite follow you.
Stand back; I'm covered in mud.

lines.zh: 泥坑比这事更急，我先去。
lines.en: The mud pit matters more; I am going there first.
I'm going to sit in the mud.
Don't grab my belly.
I shuffled away.
This mud hole is good. I'll stay.
I press my belly into the mud.
I scoop it up with my hands.

lines.zh: 我把那东西凑到鼻子底下。
lines.en: I bring the thing up under my nose.
I sniff. No.
I bite and frown.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进肚子边的泥褶里。
lines.en: I tuck it into the muddy fold beside my belly.
I only want mud and water.

lines.zh: 不是粪便，我随手丢在脚边。
lines.en: It is not dung, so I drop it by my feet.
This lump... I'll save it as ammunition.
You hid the food.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋从水里抬起来。
lines.en: I lift my head out of the water.
I shuffle over.
My belly is rumbling.

lines.zh: 我的脚印在沼泥里连成一条线。
lines.en: My footprints join into a line through the swamp mud.
I waddle over, swaying.
My belly is against you.
You raised the food.
I can smell it; very close.

lines.zh: 沼泥沾满我全身，我不在乎。
lines.en: Bog mud coats me; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我晃着肚子，朝你的食物挪。
lines.en: I wobble my belly toward your food.
I follow, dripping mud.
You step, I shuffle half.

lines.zh: 沼泥从我的指缝里往下滴。
lines.en: Swamp mud drips from between my fingers.
You smell like food.

lines.zh: 我一步一晃，脚在泥里留印。
lines.en: I sway step by step, prints in the mud.
Do you hear my steps?
You've backed to the mud.
I shuffle along behind you.
That muddy pool is behind you.
Don't ask what's in my hand.
I mean to have that food.
I swing an arm.
I flop onto you.
Soft, but heavy.
I grab your sleeve.
I lunge again and pin you.
My hand leaves mud all over your back.
You've backed into the shallows.
I sit down, panting.
I stop flopping.
I flop onto your leg.
My palm slaps you.

lines.zh: 我撑着两条胳膊站起来。
lines.en: I push up on both arms.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的水洼里撑起身。
lines.en: I push myself up out of a swamp pool.
I smell food.

lines.zh: 泥水顺着我的腿往下淌。
lines.en: Muddy water runs down my legs.
Slimy as I am, I squelch when I walk.
I found a puddle.
I squat by the pool and wait.
I splash mud all over myself.
I slowly found a hollow.
I flattened the grass here.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我身上的泥就干了。
lines.en: Fire dries the mud on me.
I flail in the water.
Violet light makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 肚子里空得只剩泥水晃荡。
lines.en: My belly is empty save for sloshing muddy water.

lines.zh: 雷光把我一身泥照得发白。
lines.en: The flash bleaches the mud on me.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，什么都没抓住。
lines.en: I fall and grab nothing.
